packageRules.description: LTS-only Node (revisit when the LTS line after 26 is announced)

PostgreSQL majors are deliberate: the on-disk format changes and every install has to migrate. The bump waits in the Dependency Dashboard; read POSTGRES.md, "Before bumping the PostgreSQL major", before ticking it. Its own group, so that no other image update waits with it.

A Python minor moves everywhere at once: the Dockerfiles, .tool-versions and the CI Python in tests.yml are one pull request. It stays open and red while a runtime dependency does not allow the new minor (meshtastic 2.7.x requires <3.15) and merges itself once the tests pass on it and the image builds.
